name: code-field
title: Code field
description: Displays controlled demo-code entry, normalizing pasted message artifacts. Does not verify codes, unlock content, store values, or make network requests. Contract: value and onChange are required; the consumer owns all state.

meta.whenToUse: You are building your own gate layout and need only the entry field, with codes pasted out of an email tidied on the way in.
meta.notFor: A complete gate screen. Use the Quick gate or Client preview gate block, which already compose this field with a heading, a submit action and lifecycle notices.
pitfalls: `length` is a display and autofill hint, not validation. The field never rejects input and never reports whether a code is correct.
`status="success"` only styles the field. Revealing content is your own `unlocked` state, decided after your own server check.
`autoFocus` moves focus on mount. Leave it off when the field sits below other content or inside a long page.
meta.contract: Displays controlled demo-code entry, normalizing pasted message artifacts. Does not verify codes, unlock content, store values, or make network requests. Contract: value and onChange are required; the consumer owns all state.

props.name: value
props.description: Current code; required. Never interpreted as authorization.

props.name: length
props.description: Maximum digit count, from 1 to 16. Ignored for passphrases.

props.name: masked
props.description: Uses a native password input and masked segments.

props.name: status
props.description: Visual state only; pending disables editing.

props.name: error
props.description: Announced error text supplied by the consumer.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional hint connected to the input.

props.name: theme
props.description: Explicit theme; omitted follows system preference.

meta.a11y: Native controls, visible focus, localized labels; lifecycle messages use polite announcements. No modal dialog is created.

docs: UI only. Read https://knock.codes/docs/code-field.md. Consumers own authorization.
